description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called PaymentFragment that provides a payment interface with various options including wallet balance, QR pay, and deep-linking methods to third-party payment apps like Paytm, Mobikwik, and Google Pay. It also includes a payment confirmation dialog flow.

classes.name: PaymentFragment
classes.description: A stateless Flutter widget representing a payment screen with various payment options and a confirmation dialog.

methods.name: _buildPaymentTile
methods.description: A helper method to build a payment method list tile with icon, name, and tap callback.

methods.name: _launchApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch an external app via a URI, shows a fallback message if not successful.

methods.name: _showPaymentDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for completing or canceling the payment.
